summary: Quick routing finished the matched ramp and analysis jobs in 2.32 s and 5.12 s with zero selection calls. On the same inputs Plan took 82.52 s and 63.52 s. An uncertain suggestion waited for confirmation and kept its original inputs across restart.

pairs.title: Paired ramps
pairs.request: Compare the two prepared ramp configurations on the same clock.
pairs.result: Every retained sample matched. The signed distance difference was +0.896 m.

pairs.title: Motion summary
pairs.request: Analyse my selected motion recording for total travel. Gap limit .12 seconds and speed limit .6 m/s.
pairs.result: Both paths checked the same original rows and reported 0.200 m of travel.
